title: S17 VERDICT: the in-tree ln-t defect law BREAKS above ~3e16 - a t^2 term joins the law (pre-registered law-correction path activated) + S1MR exact-tail repair of the S1Marg dip LAUNCHED. S17's 11 new rows (3.16e13..3.16e18, the 9e18 wall probe still running) measured the empty 5.5-decade gap: the PINNED two-term law M_defect(t) = A ln t + B (A = -25256007, B = +523513775, the 0151 audit constants) holds at O(1e4) to 3.16e16 exactly as pinned, then the residual turns negative and grows LIKE t^2: +5417 (3.16e13), +8225, +11027, +13823, +16534, +18358, +11413 (3.16e16), -83538 (1e17), -1.058e6 (3.16e17), -1.083e7 (1e18), -1.0857e8 (3.16e18); from 3.16e17 on the residual is -C*t^2 with C STABLE to 3% over 1.5 decades = -1.086035e-29. The three-term law M(t) = A ln t + B + C t^2 fits the NEW 11 rows to max|resid| 149.9 and the FULL 23-row face (3.00001e10..3.16e18, 8.5 decades) to max|resid| 7740.8 (same O(1e4) scale as the original 21-row face audit's 6704.088, rms 3206; two-term on the same face: 8.58e7 - four orders worse). Fit constants, 23-row face: A = -25254114.1337, B = +523462994.7593, C = -1.086035e-29; 11-row: A = -25253572.2127, B = +523443514.8099, C = -1.086074e-29. This voids the 0151 pre-staged E1ClauseV3 splice (same A/B, T_MEAS -> 9e18): mdefect_bounded would fail by 1.09e8 at the top rows. Revised 0153 plan: three-term defect in-tree (C pinned as the rational -1086035/10^39 or the refit integer), T_MEAS = 10^18.5 (= 3.1623e18, the new deepest row), mdefect_bounded re-pinned to a loose ~2e4 over the whole face, and component deconvolution of the t^2 term from the per-row columns (logzeta, lm, la, re, I_far all stored in the row jsonl) - the far-density I_far channel is the prime suspect (at t >> g the integrand flattens and the fixed 200-point log grid's residual error scales like the squared range, i.e. like t^2; unverified - 0153 nails it). eps column diagnostic recorded: eps = lm - lme + const = +0.7047 CONSTANT across 3.16e13..3.16e18 - the logmain25212 Stirling truncation error stops being small at extreme t, exactly as expected of a fixed-order asymptotic, but M is invariant to that error by construction (the lm cancels identically in M = lz - lme + EX_TOTAL - la - re - I_far), which the run confirms (M stays O(1e8)-clean through the transition). S1MR REPAIR (scripts/rh/s18_S1marg_repair.py, launched this unit, pid 3886696, tmp/s18_run.log): the exact-tail fix of the S1Marg exploratory dip (0151 repair-list). The day023 composite kernel K = e^{main + la + i*ar + tail} is re-run with the (3e7, 3e10] tail EXACT from the H1 certified files (1.014e11 f64 zeros, one per zero, strictly increasing, gap density verified at sample points) instead of the RVM density quad, the quad surviving only on the genuinely unmeasured (3e10, 1e18]; per-pair closed form log part re = log|g-t| + log(g+t) - log(g^2+1/4) (FACTORED: the naive g^2-t^2 cancels to garbage for |g-t| < ~2e-6 at t ~ 3e10 - 55 lost bits - a whole zero-gap of danger; the arbiter proves it: at t = 2.9e10 the naive form is off by 7e-2 vs dps-50 mpmath ground truth while the safe form matches to 12 digits), im = t/(g^2+1/4) + pi*count(g<t) (the day023 branch fix, phase on the SUM), mpmath values converted via mp.mpf(float) EXACT binary (mp.mpf(repr(float)) is a rounded decimal that at t ~ 3e10 shifts g/t by up to ulp/2 and corrupts every log|g-t| below ~ulp - caught by the arbiter's ground-truth gate; day023's own regime t <= 3.15e7 is exact under it, so the A/B comparability of the pinned 25 rows is preserved). Arbiter 5/5 green pre-launch: (a) 16... one-chunk longdouble (b) sequential Kahan f64 (c) 2-thread split three-way on A[0:5e7] (d) 400-zero dps-50 mpmath ground truth vs closed form (im matches mod 2pi, the day023 branch convention pinned by the 7 real rows) (e) danger-regime t = 2.9e10 synthetic near-equal offsets. Owner compute policy honored (1-week budget granted, pre-launch alert issued in-session): <= 16 stream threads + <= 12 row workers (serial phases, never overlapped), ~4-6 GB, 4 logical cores + 16 GB left for the OS (watch: machine already at 92 GB used / swap mostly full from s17's wall probe + lake; s18 yields on OOM, resumable: per-row jsonl + per-mode stream npz cache keyed on target list). Part 0 = A/B control: the 4 density-quad exp rows {3.1e7, 3.75e7, 5e7, 7.5e7} RE-MEASURED with the exact tail (recorded margins 0.7763/0.6609/0.3665/0.5257) - lifts above 1 => dip is a cache-edge model artifact; stays below => dip is real. Part 1 = extension: 6 REAL zeros nearest {1e8, 3e8, 1e9, 3e9, 1e10, 2.9e10} x 24 straddles (k = -12..12, k != 0, best = argmax, reissue 400 pts, dps-30, the day023 scan posture line-for-line), the certified track pushed from 2.8e7 toward 3e10. ETA part0 ~40-60min stream + ~30min rows; part1 ~1-2h stream + ~1h rows. No in-tree formal change this unit; no RH claim.
body:
## S17 verdict (pre-registered rules, 0151)

The in-tree law (formal/RhAttack/E1Clause.lean, defect_A = -25256007, defect_B = +523513775) residuals at the 11 new S17 rows (tmp/s17_M_far2.jsonl, M values dps-40 channel):

    t            M                resid vs in-tree F1
    3.16228e13   -2.6156123e8     +5417.018
    1e14         -2.9063547e8     +8224.643
    3.16228e14   -3.1970972e8     +11027.038
    1e15         -3.4878398e8     +13822.651
    3.16228e15   -3.7785832e8     +16533.515
    1e16         -4.0693355e8     +18357.628
    3.16228e16   -4.3601755e8     +11413.241
    1e17         -4.6518955e8     -83538.145
    3.16228e17   -4.9524144e8     -1058373.532
    1e18         -5.3409011e8     -10829992.918
    3.16228e18   -6.6091110e8     -108573932.305

Sign flip between 3.16e16 and 1e17; from 3.16e17 on the residual is proportional to t^2 with a stable constant:

    -resid / t^2 = 1.0584e-29 (3.16e17), 1.0830e-29 (1e18), 1.0857e-29 (3.16e18)

i.e. the missing tail is M(t) = A ln t + B + C t^2, C = -1.086e-29. Pre-registered rule "F2 or F3 wins by >= 10x => the defect law itself changes, next unit is a law-correction unit" is ACTIVATED (the t^2 family is the F3 shape -far-bias / (t/G)^2 kernel- with the far scale absorbed: the measured coefficient is the t^2 term itself).

Fits (numpy lstsq, t^2 column scaled by 1e-29):
  - 11 new rows:  A = -25253572.2127  B = +523443514.8099  C = -1.086074e-29  max|resid| = 149.86
  - 23-row face (8 s9 + 4 s16 + 11 s17, deduped on log10(t)):  A = -25254114.1337  B = +523462994.7593  C = -1.086035e-29  max|resid| = 7740.8 @ t = 3.00001e10  rms = 3206
  - two-term on the same 23-row face: max|resid| = 85773084.85 (four orders worse)

The worst 23-row residual sits on the OLD low-t rows at the original face's scale - the three-term law does not sacrifice the face it extends.

## Why the t^2 (hypothesis, 0153 to verify by component deconvolution)

M = log|zeta| - lme + EX_TOTAL - la - re - I_far (lm cancels identically - proven by design, confirmed by the run). The t^2-scale deviation at the top rows (1e8 at 3.16e18) is NOT in log|zeta| (O(ln t) scale), NOT in lme (exact mpmath), NOT in la/re (sums of 2 ln(t/g)-type terms over g <= 3e10, O(ln t) growth), so it must be in I_far - the RVM density quad over (3e10, 1e18] on the fixed 200-point log grid: for t >> g the integrand log|1 - s/rho| real part flattens to ~ln(t/g) and the grid's residual error grows with the SQUARE of the integrated range ln(t/3e10), i.e. like (ln t)^2 at leading order and like t^2 through the g^2/t^2 kernel pieces at subleading order - the clean C*t^2 with 3%-stable C over 1.5 decades says the kernel piece dominates. All components are stored per row (logzeta, lm, la, re, I_far, eps in the jsonl) so 0153 can attribute the 1.0857e8 term-by-term without re-running anything.

## The eps diagnostic (documented, not a bug)

eps = lm - lme + const = +0.70470 identical to 4 digits on ALL 11 new rows: the logmain25212 fixed-order Stirling expansion has a constant-level error once t is far past its home stretch (it is a diagnostic, stored for exactly this). M does not use the expansion: its lm occurrence cancels identically against the -lm in M's definition, so the measured M is the dps-40 channel value regardless. If a future in-tree statement quotes logmain25212, it must carry this eps annotation (or quote lme instead).

## S1MR repair (launched, resumable)

Design (scripts/rh/s18_S1marg_repair.py): day023 kernel, repaired tail (3e7, 3e10] exact over the H1 files (A (3.1946e7, 1.006e9] 2.792e9 zeros, B (1.002e9, 2.002e9] 3.066e9, C (2.002e9, 2.999e9] 3.143e9, D (2.999e9, 3.0001e10] 9.258e10; strictly increasing f64 one-per-zero verified: median gap 0.27-0.31 matches the N'(g) = ln(g/2pi)/(2pi) density at sampled depths; no duplicates in a 1e7-window sample + 20 random 500k windows), dps-30 quad only on (3e10, 1e18], same 497-d grid, k = -12..13 window minus 0, best = argmax, reissue 400pts. Two precision findings that would have silently corrupted the high-t rows if shipped uncaught:
  1. g^2 - t^2 cancellation: at t ~ 2.9e10 the naive factor loses 55 bits for |g-t| < ~2e-6 (a whole zero gap); the factored form log|g-t| + log(g+t) - log(g^2+1/4) is exact at its own scale; the bucket rows (bitwise g == t, an f64 quantization accident - a real zero cannot sit exactly at t = g_cand + k/2, k != 0) take the uniform sub-ulp mean E ln|delta| = ln(ulp(t)) - 2 instead of -inf.
  2. mp.mpf(repr(float(x))): repr is a ROUNDED decimal; at 2.9e10 the decimal '29000000000.00003' is not the binary value 29000000000.000030517578125 - up to ulp/2 shift in g/t, corrupting log|g-t| by 1.7e-2 when |g-t| ~ 3e-5 (measured). Fix: mp.mpf(float) exact binary; t built in pure f64 (t = f64(g_witness) + k/2) everywhere so keys are bit-identical.
Arbiter (5 gates, all green): (a)/(b)/(c) three-way summation on 5e7 A-head zeros (chunked longdouble vs sequential Kahan vs 2-thread split, agree to the printed digit) + (d) 400-zero dps-50 mpmath ground truth (re exact, im mod 2pi = +400pi shift = the day023 +pi-per-g<t convention) + (e) danger-regime t = 2.9e10 (safe = mpmath to 12 digits; naive g^2-t^2 off by 7.03e-2) + the day023 s0=-2 pin 6.251993491674e-07 on the (1e7, 3e7] cache.
Launch posture (owner rule): alert issued pre-kickoff; 16 stream threads then <= 12 fork row workers (serial phases), ~4-6 GB, 4 cores + 16 GB left; yields on memory pressure, resumes from tmp/s18_S1marg_repair.jsonl + mode stream caches (tmp/s18_stream_{mode}_{hash}.npz). Part 0 A/B (4 exp rows, recorded margins 0.7763/0.6609/0.3665/0.5257) decides the dip's nature; part 1 (6 real zeros toward 3e10 x 24 straddles) decides the extension. ETA ~4-6 h total. Part1 candidate zeros are taken from the H1 files themselves (nearest to {1e8, 3e8, 1e9, 3e9, 1e10, 2.9e10}), so every part-1 witness is a certified file zero.

## Status of the rest
- E1ClauseV3 splice: on hold (superseded by the three-term re-statement; 0153 does the spine: C-pinned rational, T_MEAS = 10^18.5 = 3162277660168379321 (pending 9e18 probe), mdefect_bounded ~= 2e4 loose, docstrings + cards).
- PR #69 / tracker: no change this unit (last watcher pass: board top 0.8748087 gao-five-step-affine-20261020; PR #69 open/draft, head ac76d5ef6008; paper 404).
- The 9e18 wall probe (s17 final row): running; the 11 half-decade rows are already flushed (incremental jsonl), so the verdict stands either way; if it lands, it is the 12th row and a direct test of the three-term law at the wall (predicted M(9e18) = A ln 9e18 + B + C*81e36 = -1.461e9 with the 23-row constants).
- No in-tree formal change; no RH claim.
